sharedSpecification.assetType: production master sprite atlas for a dark science-fiction 2D side-scrolling game
sharedSpecification.grid: exactly 5 horizontal rows by exactly 6 equal columns, one identity per row, 30 isolated figures total
sharedSpecification.orientation: full-body right-facing side profile except the collapsed death pose
sharedSpecification.style: original dark cinematic hand-painted pixel-art-like game sprites with crisp pixel-painted edges, realistic alien materials and high-contrast readable silhouettes
sharedSpecification.composition: wide 3:2 landscape canvas with an invisible regular 5x6 cell layout; every subject centered, fully visible and padded; no overlap or cell crossing
sharedSpecification.backdrop: perfectly flat fully uniform solid #ff00ff chroma-key background
sharedSpecification.invariants: same identity, anatomy, palette, proportions and scale across all six cells of a row; locomotion phases differ; attack, hit and death remain unambiguous
sharedSpecification.avoid: magenta in subjects, text, labels, numbers, UI, icons, borders, grid lines, cast or contact shadows, ground, scenery, gradients, reflections, particles, detached parts, cropped anatomy, watermark, logo or recognizable copyrighted character
